title: A finding shaped exactly as research-fanout.js's Research phase wrote it before #653's fix
content: This finding reproduces research-harness-template#652's real incident shape: it is ajv-valid, dimension-pinned, and carries a placeholder verdict="inconclusive" per FINDING_CONTRACT -- but the authoring agent also fabricated extensions.harness.verification.attempted_at at creation time, before the falsification gate ever ran. That fabricated timestamp is the exact defect: it makes the falsification gate's one-round rule treat this finding as already-attempted and permanently skip it.
summary: Handoff-eval fixture: fabricates attempted_at exactly like #652's real defect, to prove the strip removes it and the gate then genuinely grades it.
